services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: All camps are based on camper’s grade completed in June. Rates listed do not include GST. We know that sending your littles to camp is a big decision, and we keep in mind that this is likely their first time away from home, so we jam pack the week with fun games and activities to give them the most fun week of their summer! This week is a great “intro to summer camp” and offers fun age appropriate programming such as theme meals and events, field games, chapel and campfire songs, and teachings. Each week we bring in a speaker for chapel and campfire, and children do devotions in their cabins each night. This schedule is to give you an idea of what campers might do in a day at this camp. in
